agyos_skill.instructions: The most valuable thing this skill does is correct an outdated belief. In 2026, **hashtags are not a reach hack** — platforms understand content directly (captions, on-screen text, audio, visuals, engagement), so tags now mostly **categorize** a post and **aid search**. Instagram even removed hashtag-following (2024) and **caps hashtags at 5** (2025), and its own head has said more tags don't mean more reach. So this skill does two jobs, in order: 1. **The keyword / social-SEO layer first** — the real discovery lever. Platforms are search engines now; they index your caption, on-screen text, and spoken audio. 2. **A tight, relevant hashtag set** on top — per platform, within caps, niche over generic — plus branded/campaign tags where community applies. (Full reasoning in `references/the-2026-reality.md`.) Load `brand-profile.md` and `audience.md`, and look at the actual content/caption being tagged. Tags must match real content and the audience's real searches. Pick the **primary keyword** (how the audience actually searches) + a couple of variations, and place them where platforms index: - **Caption, front-loaded** (the first ~80 chars carry most weight). - **On-screen text** (Reels/TikTok/Shorts). - **Spoken audio** (video) — say the keyword aloud; on TikTok the "triple mention" (say + show + caption) is the core ranking move. This does more for discovery than any tag. Don't skip it to jump to hashtags. Per `references/platform-playbook.md`: Instagram 3–5 (hard cap 5), TikTok 3–5 as keywords, LinkedIn 3–5 specific, X 0–2, Threads 1, Pinterest/YouTube keywords-led. Favor **mid-tier/niche tags (~10K–500K posts)** over mega-tags; mix topic + niche/community + (sometimes) location/branded. Vet each tag on its page before using (see `references/research-and-types.md`). For community/UGC/tracking, design a **branded** tag (ongoing) or **campaign** tag (time-bound):
